biography.value:
Published alignment: N/LN.

Description

This young wingless dragon has rocky scales with two large horns. Brown dragons usually live in caves or underground.

Defense

AC 21, touch 10, flat-footed 21 (+11 natural)

hp 113 (9d12+54)

mp 34

Fort +11, Ref +8, Will +12

DR 5/magic; Immune Earth, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Lightning 50%

Weakness Wind

Offense

Speed 60 ft., burrow 40 ft.

Melee Bite +16 (1d8+10), 2 Claws +16 (1d6+7), Gore +16 (1d6+10)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite & gore)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (60-ft. line, 4d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 19 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Earthquake, Slow Breath (40-ft. cone, DC 19)

Special Abilities Triumphant Roar

Spells Known (FC CL 9th, Concentration +13)

At will - detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 15) - pass without trace, stone fist

2nd (DC 16) - binding earth, elemental resistance, groundswell, soften earth and stone, stone call, wall climb

3rd (DC 17) - dispel, meld into stone, shifting sand, stone shape

Statistics

Str 24, Dex 10, Con 20, Int 9, Wis 18, Cha 12

Base Atk +9; CMB +16; CMD 26 (30 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness

Skills Bluff +13, Climb +23, Intimidate +13, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +12, Perception +16, Stealth +16; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth

Languages Draconic

SQ Earth glide

description.value: Burrow through natural earth or stone without disturbing it; cannot glide through metal.
Special attack listed in the source statblock: Breath Weapon (60-ft. line, 4d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 19 half, usable every 1d4 rounds).

effect: Alternate use of the same breath charge; slowed for 1d6+4 rounds.

ffd20-bestiary-builder.sourceText: Breath Weapon (60-ft. line, 4d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 19 half, usable every 1d4 rounds)

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a brown dragon can cause the ground to erupt around it within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d6 rounds (Reflex save DC 18 for half damage and negates the status effect). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

effect: Half and negate Weighted on save; otherwise Weighted 1d6 rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

description.value: As a standard action, the brown dragon releases a raging fierce roar, boosting their personal attack power. This adds a +6 morale bonus to all attack rolls for nine rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

effect: Gain +6 morale on attacks for nine rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).
